PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: TPS610994DRVR assigns FB (FB) whereas TPS61221DCKR assigns GND (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 4: TPS610994DRVR assigns EN (EN) whereas TPS61221DCKR assigns VOUT (VOUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS610994DRVR uses WSON-6 (6-pin, DRV) while TPS61221DCKR uses SC-70-6 (6-pin, DCK); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs VIN), Pin 3 (FB vs GND), Pin 4 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 6 (VIN vs EN). Soldering TPS61221DCKR onto a TPS610994DRVR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (WSON-6: GND vs SC-70-6: NONE); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS610994DRVR: 2.2 µH p.4 vs TPS61221DCKR: 4.7 µH p.13); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS610994DRVR specifies 1000 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5) vs TPS61221DCKR 400 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.4). Remember boost Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle scaling.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 69% (TPS610994DRVR: 71.7 °C/W p.4 vs TPS61221DCKR: 231.2 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: TPS610994DRVR (Texas Instruments, WSON-6) and TPS61221DCKR (Texas Instruments, SC-70-6) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs VIN), Pin 3 (FB vs GND), Pin 4 (EN vs VOUT), Pin 6 (VIN vs EN); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Key datasheet deltas: topology is boost (sync) vs boost (sync), switching frequency is 1116 kHz (p.16) vs 812 kHz (p.14), rated current is 1000 mA (p.5) vs 400 mA (p.4), typical inductor is 2.2 µH (p.4) vs 4.7 µH (p.13), and Iq is 1 µA (p.5) vs 5.5 µA (p.4). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 71.7 vs 231.2 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
